name: Mechanical stop-latch indication
summary: A stop-latch indication identifies a mechanically retained control position.
description: A stop-latch indication identifies a mechanically retained control position. A stop latch mechanically retains a position until its specified release action occurs. The mechanism state can be maintained without an electrical holding coil remaining energised.
Identify the retained movement and the release/reset path. If position is reported electrically, cross-reference the feedback contact rather than assuming the latch indication supplies that signal.
readingNotes: Specify the release action and the controlled device relationship.
A stop latch is distinct from a timer holding a circuit electrically.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.

distinction: A stop latch is distinct from a timer holding a circuit electrically.
